Contents: Norman Osborn (I) and Norman Osborn (II). (Norman Osborn (II) and Norman Osborn (III) instead for expert mode.) Risky Business and Standard encounter sets. One modular encounter set (recommended: Goblin Gimmicks). Setup: Put the Criminal Enterprise environment into play. Shuffle the encounter deck. Advance to stage 1B.
When Completed: Place 1[per_hero] infamy counters on Criminal Enterprise. Then discard 1 card from each player's deck for each infamy counter on Criminal Enterprise.
When Revealed: Advance to stage 2B.
If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.
Criminal Enterprise enters play with 2[per_hero] infamy counters on it. If there are no infamy counters here, flip Norman Osborn and Criminal Enterprise.
State of Madness enters play with 2[per_hero] madness counters on it. If there are no madness counters here, flip Green Goblin and State of Madness.
